description: This file defines a class MessageFormatter in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which provides functionality to format HTTP messages for logging purposes, supporting variable placeholders for requests, responses, headers, bodies, timestamps, and other transactional data.

classes.name: MessageFormatter
classes.description: A class that formats HTTP request and response messages into log strings, supporting various variable substitutions such as request, response, headers, bodies, and timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MessageFormatter with an optional custom template string; defaults to the CLF format.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted log string from a given HTTP request, optional response, and optional error, replacing placeholders with actual message data.
